description: Phase 6bp gate — two post-6bo residuals from random corpus: (1) SELECT expressions and aggregates with no FROM clause, (2) Rust-only dedup-slot allocation bug in compile_joined_aggregated_no_group_by (SUM(DISTINCT) + multi-table FROM).

cases.name: count-star-no-from
cases.description: COUNT(*) with no FROM counts one synthetic row: result is 1.

cases.name: sum-no-from
cases.description: SUM with no FROM aggregates over one synthetic row: SUM(5) → 5. Matches upstream corpus SUM(79) → 79.

cases.name: min-no-from
cases.description: MIN with no FROM returns the argument's value (one-element aggregate set).

cases.name: count-null-arg-no-from
cases.description: COUNT(expr) with no FROM: 1 if expr non-NULL, 0 if NULL. Standard NULL-skipping.

cases.name: sum-null-arg-no-from
cases.description: SUM(NULL) with no FROM: aggregate set is empty after NULL-skipping, result is NULL.

cases.name: coalesce-agg-no-from
cases.description: The shape that appears in random/expr: COALESCE(...aggregate..., fallback) with no FROM. Validates the end-to-end expression tree.

program.sql: SELECT 74 * - COALESCE(+ CASE - CASE WHEN NOT (NOT -79 >= NULL) THEN 48 END WHEN + + COUNT(*) THEN 6 END, MIN(-30) * 45 * 77) * -14;

cases.name: multi-col-no-from
cases.description: Two projection items with no FROM.

cases.name: sum-distinct-multi-table
cases.description: Rust-only regression: SUM(DISTINCT …) + multi-table FROM previously panicked with 'index out of bounds: len is 0 but index is 0' at AggDedupReset. Both targets must now pass.

cases.name: count-distinct-cross-join
cases.description: Mirror of sum-distinct-multi-table with COUNT DISTINCT, aggregating real column values across the cross product.

program.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT x) FROM a, b;

cases.name: sum-distinct-cross-join-composed
cases.description: COUNT(*) and SUM(DISTINCT) together in one projection, matching the random-corpus label-2081 shape.

program.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) * -62 - SUM(DISTINCT 91) FROM a, b;

cases.name: multi-agg-nested-no-from
cases.description: Engine bug #110 regression: aggregate whose argument contains a CASE expression. In `compile_group_expr` the AggregateCall-resolution loop iterates `all_aggs` and compares `arg` via `aggregate_args_equal` / `expressions_equal`; prior to this fix `expressions_equal` lacked a `Case` arm, so the self-match failed and the AggregateCall fell through to the `unreachable!` panic 'AggregateCall should have been resolved above'. Minimal shape: SUM(CASE WHEN 1 THEN 2 END) with no FROM. Original trigger is random/expr/slt_good_0.test label-345 (`SELECT ... SUM(- CASE - - 32 WHEN - 53 THEN - 59 WHEN - + 66 * + 48 THEN + - 86 END) ...`). Equivalent `expressions_equal` gaps for `Glob` and `InSubquery` were patched at the same time for symmetry.
